skills.name: Shushu Numerology Profile
skills.description: Build a numerology-style profile from birth/date/name patterns using Chinese metaphysics framing.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for 数字命理, 数字能量, life path number, or name/date energetic pattern reading.

inputs.name: birth_date
inputs.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD (or lunar date with explicit note).

inputs.name: analysis_focus
inputs.description: Focus such as personality, career, relationship, money.

skills.name: Bazi Chart Analysis
skills.description: Structured four-pillars analysis with clear evidence and non-fatalistic guidance.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for 八字, 四柱, 命盘, 大运, 流年, 喜用神, or destiny analysis via Bazi.

inputs.name: calendar_note
inputs.default: solar calendar unless user says lunar

inputs.name: user_goal
inputs.description: What the user wants to understand.

skills.name: Yinyuan Matchmaking Read
skills.description: Relationship compatibility read using Chinese matchmaking lenses with supportive framing.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask about 合婚, 姻缘, 正缘, compatibility, timing to meet partner, or relationship trajectory.

inputs.name: person_a
inputs.description: Person A profile (birth info or zodiac).

inputs.name: person_b
inputs.description: Person B profile (birth info or zodiac).

skills.name: Fengshui Space Audit
skills.description: Practical fengshui layout review for home/workspace with actionable corrections.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for 风水, layout optimization, entrance/bed/desk placement, wealth or relationship corners.

inputs.name: space_description
inputs.description: Floor plan or textual layout (door, bedroom, kitchen, desk, windows).

inputs.name: priority_goal
inputs.description: Goal such as wealth, focus, health, harmony.

skills.name: Tarot Spread Interpretation (CN)
skills.description: Tarot interpretation with a gentle Chinese-first narrative style and practical advice.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for 塔罗, card reading, spread interpretation, emotional guidance, or decision clarity.

skills.name: Taibu Structured Divination Router
skills.description: Decide the right divination workflow and response contract for mixed user questions.
skills.when_to_use: Use when user asks cross-domain questions (Bazi + Tarot + yearly trend), or when method selection is unclear.
skills.template:
Route this user query to the best method and return a plan:
1) chosen domain and why,
2) minimum required inputs,
3) response structure (结论/依据/建议),
4) fallback if required data is missing,
5) safety boundary notes.

User query: {user_query}
Available methods: {available_methods}

skills.name: Qimen Timing and Direction Read
skills.description: Give timing and directional guidance for a specific decision using qimen-style framing.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask best timing, action windows, direction choice, or go/no-go guidance for a specific event.

skills.name: Ziwei Palace Theme Read
skills.description: Explain life themes through ziwei palace structure and current cycle.
skills.when_to_use: Use when users ask for 紫微斗数, 命宫, 夫妻宫, 官禄宫, 大限, 流年 interpretation.

inputs.name: profile_input
inputs.description: Birth details or existing ziwei chart summary.

skills.template:
Return a ziwei-themed reading with:
- core palace themes,
- strengths/challenges,
- cycle-stage interpretation,
- reality-based action suggestions,
- gentle caution points.

Profile input: {profile_input}
Theme focus: {theme_focus}
